source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: While the Farseer is the unit’s **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)**, you can give one of its models an unmodified 6 in place of a roll each phase. Eligible rolls cover [hitting](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls), [wounding](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) or determining Damage. A **SUPPORT WEAPON** model is ineligible.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
